citation: Rowe and Kennicutt (2009), Northern Gulf of Mexico Continental Slope Habitats and Benthic Ecology Study, Final Report, MMS 2009-039, July 2009.

case.contour_level_assignment: intermediate line between labeled 0 and 10 cm contours, checked against the 5 cm color-key intervals

source_locator: Figure 8-5, printed page 82 / PDF page 104; named Quick-west/QE2-east split description on printed page 83 / PDF page 105.
limitations: Manual visible extremum readout of a particular plotted 5 cm SSH isoline, not an automated closed contour extraction or a physical eddy boundary. The 5 cm line is the intermediate line between the labeled 0 and 10 cm contours, consistent with the 5 cm color-key increments.

The source states Quick is west and QE2 east after a summer split. The source-case association to registry QE-2 is punctuation normalization and split context only; no physical identity crosswalk is established.

The selected contour is distinct from the labeled 10 cm inner contour, its text mask, the outer 0 cm contour, the western Quick feature, northern slope highs and the main Loop Current. Do not use a text-covered inner contour as a whole-eddy extent.

Six native pixels per extremum and two-pixel shifts on six axis anchors across 64 cases, followed by outward 25 km rounding, cover reading sensitivity only. Manual interpretation, raster distortion, source analysis error, SSH reference and physical-boundary uncertainty are unquantified.
The source specifies SSH but does not establish its datum here. The plotted 5 cm level is not assumed equivalent to modern native ADT or an OSW speed-core boundary.
The August 8, 2002 map label is not proof of exact simultaneous sampling or a formation date, lifetime or annual range.

The previous unique-peak speed-core test rejected both step sizes for multiple peaks. Both previous neutral-ink closure tests remain rejected. No gates relaxed, peaks moved, source gaps repaired or automatic closure inferred. This is a separate manual chart-isoline quantity.
No polygon, area, diameter, radius, principal width, state join, ranking, seasonal playback or source-asset republication admitted.
